svg.aria-label: How it works, animated: yolow64 Base64 field extraction, yolowzstd two-symbol Huffman lookup, yolowhtml block scoring with threshold and Viterbi smoothing, yolowpdf glyph boxes from the text matrix.
svg.text: The one idea that makes each crate fast or right, played out step by step.

g.text: Base64 · 3 bytes become 4 characters · AVX-512 does 48 → 64 per step
vpmultishiftqb pulls out the 6-bit fields, vpermb looks up all 64 lanes at once
Huffman decode · one 12-bit table hit can return two symbols
4,096 entries (16 KiB), built only when two short codes are likely to fit in 12 bits
Main content · score every DOM block, cut at θ* = F1*/2, smooth with Viterbi
the cut keeps high scores; Viterbi keeps runs together (scores illustrative)
Born-digital PDF · every glyph box comes straight from the text matrix
glyphs → lines → columns → reading order, without rasterising the page
